33:1 Then the spoke to Moses, Depart, go up from here, you and the people whom you have brought up from the land of Egypt, to the land of which I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your descendants I will give it.
33:2 And I will send an angel before you and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
33:3 to a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will not go up in your midst, because you are an obstinate people, and I might destroy you on the way.
33:4 When the people heard this sad word, they went into mourning, and none of them put on his jewelry.
33:5 For the had said to Moses, Say to the sons of Israel, You are an obstinate people; I were to go up in your midst for one moment, I would destroy you. So now, take off your jewelry that I may know what I shall do to you.
33:6 So the sons of Israel stripped themselves of their jewelry, from Mount Horeb .
33:7 Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it outside the camp, a good distance from the camp, and he called it the tent of meeting. And everyone who sought the would go out to the tent of meeting which was outside the camp.
33:8 And it came about, whenever Moses went out to the tent, that all the people would arise and stand, each at the entrance of his tent, and gaze after Moses until he entered the tent.
33:9 Whenever Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance of the tent; and the would speak with Moses.
33:10 When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, all the people would stand and worship, each at the entrance of his tent.
33:11 So the used to speak to Moses face to face, just as a man speaks to his friend. When Moses returned to the camp, his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, would not depart from the tent.
33:12 Then Moses said to the , See, You say to me, Bring up this people! But You Yourself have not let me know whom You will send with me. Moreover, You have said, I have known you by name, and you have also found favor in My sight.
33:13 Now then, if I have found favor in Your sight in any way, please let me know Your ways so that I may know You, in order that I may find favor in Your sight. Consider too, that this nation is Your people.
33:14 And He said, My presence shall go , and I will give you rest.
33:15 Then he said to Him, If Your presence does not go , do not lead us up from here.
33:16 For how then can it be known that I have found favor in Your sight, I and Your people? Is it not by Your going with us, so that we, I and Your people, may be distinguished from all the people who are on the face of the earth?
33:17 The said to Moses, I will also do this thing of which you have spoken; for you have found favor in My sight and I have known you by name.
33:18 Then said, Please, show me Your glory!
33:19 And He said, I Myself will make all My goodness pass before you, and will proclaim the name of the before you; and I will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will show compassion to whom I will show compassion.
33:20 He further said, You cannot see My face, for mankind shall not see Me and live!
33:21 Then the said, Behold, there is a place by Me, and you shall stand on the rock;
33:22 and it will come about, while My glory is passing by, that I will put you in the cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
33:23 Then I will take My hand away and you shall see My back, but My face shall not be seen.
34:1 Now the said to Moses, Cut out for yourself two stone tablets like the former ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets which you smashed.
34:2 So be ready by morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to Me on the top of the mountain.
34:3 And no one is to come up with you, nor let anyone be seen anywhere on the mountain; even the flocks and the herds are not to graze in front of that mountain.
34:4 So he cut out two stone tablets like the former ones, and Moses got up early in the morning and went up to Mount Sinai, as the had commanded him, and he took two stone tablets in his hand.
34:5 And the descended in the cloud and stood there with him as he called upon the name of the .
34:6 Then the passed by in front of him and proclaimed, The , the God, compassionate and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in faithfulness and truth;
34:7 who keeps faithfulness for thousands, who forgives wrongdoing, violation , and sin; yet He will by no means leave unpunished, inflicting the punishment of fathers on the children and on the grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.
34:8 And Moses hurried to bow low toward the ground and worship.
34:9 Then he said, If in any way I have found favor in Your sight, Lord, please may the Lord go along in our midst, even though the people are so obstinate, and pardon our wrongdoing and our sin, and take us as Your own possession.
34:10 Then God said, Behold, I am going to make a covenant. Before all your people I will perform miracles which have not been produced in all the earth nor among any of the nations; and all the people among whom you live will see the working of the , for it is a fearful thing that I am going to perform with you.
34:11 Be sure to comply with what I am commanding you this day: behold, I am going to drive out the Amorite from you, and the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
34:12 Be careful that you do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land into which you are going, or it will become a snare in your midst.
34:13 But , you are to tear down their altars and smash their memorial stones, and cut down their Asherim
34:14 —for you shall not worship any other god, because the , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God—
34:15 otherwise you might make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they would prostitute themselves with their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and someone might invite you to eat of his sacrifice,
34:16 and you might take some of his daughters for your sons, and his daughters might prostitute themselves with their gods and cause your sons to prostitute themselves with their gods.
34:17 You shall not make for yourself gods cast in metal.
34:18 You shall keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.
34:19 The firstborn from every womb belongs to Me, and all your male livestock, the firstborn from cattle and sheep.
34:20 You shall redeem with a lamb the firstborn from a donkey; and if you do not redeem , then you shall break its neck. You shall redeem all the firstborn of your sons. None are to appear before Me empty-handed.
34:21 You shall work six days, but on the seventh day you shall rest; during plowing time and harvest you shall rest.
34:22 And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks, , the first fruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.
34:23 Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord , the God of Israel.
34:24 For I will drive out nations from you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the your God.
34:25 You shall not offer the blood of My sacrifice with leavened bread, nor is the sacrifice of the Feast of the Passover to be left over until morning.
34:26 You shall bring the very first of the first fruits of your soil into the house of the your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mothers milk.
34:27 Then the said to Moses, Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.
34:28 So he was there with the for forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread or drink water. And He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
34:29 And it came about, when Moses was coming down from Mount Sinai (and the two tablets of the testimony in Moses hand as he was coming down from the mountain), that Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because of his speaking with Him.
34:30 So when Aaron and all the sons of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone, and they were afraid to approach him.
34:31 Then Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers in the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
34:32 Afterward all the sons of Israel came near, and he commanded them everything that the had spoken to him on Mount Sinai.
34:33 When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.
34:34 But whenever Moses went in before the to speak with Him, he would take off the veil until he came out; and whenever he came out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he had been commanded,
34:35 the sons of Israel would see the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses face shone. So Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with Him.
35:1 Then Moses assembled all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and said to them, These are the things that the has commanded to do:
35:2 For six days work may be done, but on the seventh day you shall have a holy , a Sabbath of complete rest to the ; whoever does any work on it shall be put to death.
35:3 You shall not kindle a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.
35:4 Moses spoke to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the has commanded, saying,
35:5 Take from among you a contribution to the ; whoever is of a willing heart is to bring it as the contribution: gold, silver, and bronze,
35:6 and violet, purple, and scarlet , fine linen, goats ,
35:7 and rams skins dyed red, and fine leather, and acacia wood,
35:8 and oil for lighting, and spices for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense,
35:9 and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and for the breastpiece.
35:10 Have every skillful person among you come and make all that the has commanded:
35:11 the tabernacle, its tent and its covering, its hooks and its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
35:12 the ark and its poles, the atoning cover, and the covering curtain;
35:13 the table and its poles, and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
35:14 the lampstand also for the light and its utensils and its lamps, and the oil for the light;
35:15 and the altar of incense and its poles, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway at the entrance of the tabernacle;
35:16 the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
35:17 the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;
35:18 the pegs of the tabernacle and the pegs of the courtyard and their ropes;
35:19 the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.
35:20 Then all the congregation of the sons of Israel departed from Moses presence.
35:21 And everyone whose heart stirred him and everyone whose spirit moved him came brought the contribution for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service, and for the holy garments.
35:22 Then all whose hearts moved them, both men and women, came brought brooches and earrings and signet rings and bracelets, all articles of gold; so everyone who presented an offering of gold to the .
35:23 Everyone who was in possession of violet, purple, or scarlet or fine linen or goats , or rams skins dyed red or fine leather, brought them.
35:24 Everyone who could make a contribution of silver and bronze brought the contribution; and everyone who was in possession of acacia wood for any work of the service brought it.
35:25 And all the skilled women spun with their hands, and brought what they had spun, violet, purple, scarlet , and fine linen.
35:26 And all the women whose heart stirred with a skill spun the goats .
35:27 The rulers, moreover, brought the onyx stones and the stones for setting for the ephod and for the breastpiece;
35:28 and the spice and the oil for the light and for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
35:29 The Israelites, all the men and women, whose heart moved them to bring for all the work, which the had commanded through Moses to be done, brought a voluntary offering to the .
35:30 Then Moses said to the sons of Israel, See, the has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
35:31 And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all craftsmanship;
35:32 to create designs for working in gold, in silver, and in bronze,
35:33 and in the cutting of stones for settings and in the carving of wood, so as to perform in every inventive work.
35:34 He also has put in his heart to teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
35:35 He has filled them with skill to perform every work of an engraver, of a designer, and of an embroiderer, in violet, purple, in scarlet , and in fine linen, and of a weaver, as performers of every work and makers of designs.
36:1 Now Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skillful person in whom the has put skill and understanding to know how to perform all the work in the construction of the sanctuary, shall perform in accordance with everything that the has commanded.
36:2 Then Moses called Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skillful person in whom the had put skill, everyone whose heart stirred him, to come to the work to perform it.
36:3 They received from Moses every contribution which the sons of Israel had brought to perform the work in the construction of the sanctuary. And they still bringing to him voluntary offerings every morning.
36:4 And all the skillful people who were performing all the work of the sanctuary came, each from the work which they were performing,
36:5 and they said to Moses, The people are bringing much more than enough for the construction work which the commanded to perform.
36:6 So Moses issued a command, and circulated a proclamation throughout the camp, saying, No man or woman is to perform work any longer for the contributions of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing .
36:7 For the material they had was sufficient and more than enough for all the work, to perform it.
36:8 All the skillful people among those who were performing the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twisted linen and violet, purple, and scarlet , with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer, Bezalel made them.
36:9 The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits; all the curtains had the same measurements.
36:10 He joined five curtains to one another, and five curtains he joined to one another.
36:11 And he made loops of violet on the edge of the outermost curtain in the first set; he did likewise on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second set.
36:12 He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was in the second set; the loops were opposite each other.
36:13 He also made fifty clasps of gold, and joined the curtains to one another with the clasps, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
36:14 Then he made curtains of goats for a tent over the tabernacle; he made eleven curtains .
36:15 The length of each curtain thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain; the eleven curtains had the same measurements.
36:16 He joined five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
36:17 Moreover, he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the set, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain the second set.
36:18 He also made fifty clasps of bronze to join the tent together so that it would be a unit.
36:19 And he made a covering for the tent of rams skins dyed red, and a covering of fine leather above.
36:20 Then he made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.
36:21 Ten cubits the length of each board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
36:22 two tenons for each board, fitted to one another; he did this to all the boards of the tabernacle.
36:23 So he made the boards for the tabernacle: twenty boards for the south side;
36:24 and he made forty bases of silver under the twenty boards; two bases under one board for its two tenons, and two bases under another board for its two tenons.
36:25 Then for the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards,
36:26 and their forty bases of silver; two bases under one board, and two bases under another board.
36:27 And for the back of the tabernacle, to the west, he made six boards.
36:28 He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle at the back.
36:29 They were double beneath, and together they were complete to its top, to the first ring; he did this with both of them for the two corners.
36:30 There were eight boards with their bases of silver, sixteen bases, two bases under every board.
36:31 Then he made bars of acacia wood, five for the boards of one side of the tabernacle,
36:32 and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the back to the west.
36:33 And he made the middle bar to pass through in the center of the boards from end to end.
36:34 Then he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold holders for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
36:35 Moreover, he made the veil of violet, purple, and scarlet , and fine twisted linen; he made it with cherubim, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
36:36 And he made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold, with their hooks of gold; and he cast four bases of silver for them.
36:37 He also made a curtain for the doorway of the tent, of violet, purple, and scarlet , and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver;
36:38 and its five pillars with their hooks, and he overlaid their tops and their bands with gold; but their five bases were of bronze.
37:1 Now Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood; its length was two and a half cubits, its width one and a half cubits, and its height one and a half cubits;
37:2 and he overlaid it with pure gold inside and out, and made a gold molding for it all around.
37:3 He cast four rings of gold for it on its four feet; two rings on one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
37:4 And he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
37:5 He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry it.
37:6 He also made an atoning cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
37:7 And he made two cherubim of gold; he made them of hammered work at the two ends of the atoning cover:
37:8 one cherub at the one end and one cherub at the other end; he made the cherubim with the atoning cover at the two ends.
37:9 And the cherubim had wings spread upward, covering the atoning cover with their wings, with their faces toward each other; the faces of the cherubim were toward the atoning cover.
37:10 Then he made the table of acacia wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high.
37:11 He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding for it all around.
37:12 And he made a rim for it of a hand width all around, and made a gold molding for its rim all around.
37:13 He also cast four gold rings for it and put the rings on the four corners that were on its four legs.
37:14 Close by the rim were the rings, the holders for the poles to carry the table.
37:15 And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.
37:16 He also made the utensils which were on the table, its dishes, its pans, its libation bowls, and its jars, with which to pour out drink offerings, of pure gold.
37:17 Then he made the lampstand of pure gold. He made the lampstand of hammered work, its base and its shaft; its cups, its bulbs, and its flowers were with it.
37:18 There were six branches going out of its sides; three branches of the lampstand from the one side of it and three branches of the lampstand from the other side of it;
37:19 three cups shaped like almond , a bulb and a flower on one branch, and three cups shaped like almond , a bulb and a flower on the other branch—so for the six branches going out of the lampstand.
37:20 And on the lampstand four cups shaped like almond , its bulbs and its flowers;
37:21 and a bulb was under the pair of branches out of it, and a bulb under the pair of branches out of it, and a bulb under the pair of branches out of it, for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.
37:22 Their bulbs and their branches were with it; the whole of it a single hammered work of pure gold.
37:23 And he made its seven lamps with its tongs and its trays of pure gold.
37:24 He made it and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.
37:25 Then he made the altar of incense of acacia wood: a cubit long and a cubit wide, square, and two cubits high; its horns were with it.
37:26 And he overlaid it with pure gold, its top and its sides all around, and its horns; and he made a gold molding for it all around.
37:27 He also made two golden rings for it under its molding, on its two sides—on opposite sides—as holders for poles with which to carry it.
37:28 And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
37:29 Then he made the holy anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense of spices, the work of a perfumer.

39:1 Now from the violet, purple, and scarlet they made finely woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, as well as the holy garments which were for Aaron, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:2 He made the ephod of gold of violet, purple, and scarlet , and fine twisted linen.
39:3 Then they hammered out gold sheets and cut into threads to be woven in the violet, the purple, and the scarlet , and the fine linen, the work of a skilled embroiderer.
39:4 They made attaching shoulder pieces for the ephod; it was attached at its two ends.
39:5 And the skillfully woven band of its overlay which was on it was like its workmanship, of the same material: of gold of violet, purple, and scarlet , and fine twisted linen, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:6 They also made the onyx stones, set in gold filigree ; they were engraved the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel.
39:7 And he placed them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod memorial stones for the sons of Israel, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:8 And he made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled embroiderer, like the workmanship of the ephod: of gold of violet, purple, and scarlet and fine twisted linen.
39:9 It was square; they made the breastpiece folded double, a span long and a span wide when folded double.
39:10 And they mounted four rows of stones on it. The first row a row of ruby, topaz, and emerald;
39:11 and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
39:12 and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
39:13 and the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. They were set in gold filigree when they were mounted.
39:14 The stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel; they were twelve, corresponding to their names, the engravings of a signet, each with its name for the twelve tribes.
39:15 And they made for the breastpiece chains like cords, work of twisted cords of pure gold.
39:16 They made two gold filigree and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
39:17 Then they put the two gold cords in the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
39:18 And they put the two ends of the two cords on the two filigree , and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front of it.
39:19 They made two gold rings and placed on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge which was next to the ephod.
39:20 Furthermore, they made two gold rings and placed them on the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on the front of it, close to the place where it joined, above the woven band of the ephod.
39:21 And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a violet cord, so that it would be on the woven band of the ephod, and that the breastpiece would not come loose from the ephod, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:22 Then he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of violet;
39:23 and the opening of the robe was in the center, as the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding all around its opening, so that it would not be torn.
39:24 And they made pomegranates of violet, purple, and scarlet twisted on the hem of the robe.
39:25 They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates all around on the hem of the robe,
39:26 alternating a bell and a pomegranate all around on the hem of the robe for the service, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:27 They also made the tunics of finely woven linen for Aaron and his sons,
39:28 and the turban of fine linen, and the decorated caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,
39:29 and the sash of fine twisted linen, and violet, purple, and scarlet , the work of the weaver, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:30 They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and inscribed it like the engravings of a signet, Holy to the .
39:31 Then they fastened a violet cord to it, to fasten it on the turban above, just as the had commanded Moses.
39:32 So all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting was completed; and the sons of Israel did according to all that the had commanded Moses; so they did.
39:33 Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its furnishings: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its bases;
39:34 and the covering of rams skins dyed red, and the covering of fine leather, and the covering curtain;
39:35 the ark of the testimony, its poles, and the atoning cover;
39:36 the table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
39:37 the pure lampstand, with its arrangement of lamps and all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
39:38 and the gold altar, and the anointing oil and the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;
39:39 the bronze altar and its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
39:40 the hangings for the courtyard, its pillars and its bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and its pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting;
39:41 the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons, to serve as priests.
